summary.text: Joe Kerwin is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 125 who has served since December 1, 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney and has served in the U.S. Army National Guard since 2012.

paragraphs.text: Joe Kerwin graduated from Upper Dauphin Area High School in 2011.
Kerwin earned a degree in political science in 2015 and a J.D. in 2019, both from Pennsylvania State University.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
Ballotpedia lists his U.S. Army National Guard service as beginning in 2012.
Kerwin took office in the Pennsylvania House on December 1, 2020, succeeding Mike Tobash, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Agriculture & Rural Affairs, Game & Fisheries, and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness.
